actual_scope: On the pinned r437-carrier-integration source entry, certify that the parent payload is exactly 9475*3^124 times the executed 972-bit child, so a one-visit-per-symbol fixed-tape blank-return of the parent is not paid by that execution.
scope_change_reason: Open question 1 of research/r437-carrier-integration asks to bind the checked source entry and the full parent spectator multiplicity to the uniform fixed-tape blank-return. This package certifies that multiplicity and shows the executed child does not pay it. It does not rerun the pooled compiler, rederive the reverse coefficient, or admit the carrier.
bottleneck_link: The paid R437 exchange cannot raise the selected exponent until its parent blank-return and the other unpaid C/D terms are charged. This separates the executed packet from the parent payload by an exact factor instead of treating the local lane decreases as that charge.
stop_rule: Stop when the lcm, unused-row quotient and parent/executed ratio are certified, or when one of those stated identities fails. Do not execute physical.py, the pooled compiler, or the 9475-row parent.
evidence: verify.py prints PASS_R437_PARENT_SPECTATOR_BLANK with rows 9475, omitted_coordinates 124, executed_bits 972, parent_over_executed 9475*3^124 and blank_return_discharged false. test_verify.py prints PASS_R437_PARENT_SPECTATOR_BLANK_CONTROLS. PROOF.md records the gcd and the extent cancellation. No new kappa.
